third_party_evaluations.summary: Professional-level network programmability (350-901 AUTOCOR, rebranded CCNP Automation).

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded three-year profile and advanced network programmability support professional delivery decisions; vendor specificity bounds its use as a general application-security credential.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The recorded professional programmability scope and three-year profile support responsibility for production automation. Proctoring helps knowledge assurance, but the evidence does not demonstrate practical secure coding across platforms.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded professional programmability scope and three-year experience profile support responsibility for network-automation delivery. An unspecified proctored exam does not establish expert AppSec work.
